class.name: AudioStreamMIDIBase
class.brief_description: Shared OPL3 synthesizer configuration for [AudioStreamMIDI] and [AudioStreamMIDISequencer].
class.description: Abstract base class shared by [AudioStreamMIDI] and [AudioStreamMIDISequencer], holding the optional custom WOPL bank ([member bank_data]). The stream itself is read-only: the synthesizer settings are [AudioStreamPlayer] parameters, set in the Inspector or in code as [code]parameters/[/code] via [method Object.set]: - [code]embedded_bank[/code] (int): index of one of libADLMIDI's built-in banks; ignored if [member bank_data] is set. See [method AudioStreamMIDI.get_bank_count] and [method AudioStreamMIDI.get_bank_name]. - [code]num_chips[/code] (int): number of emulated OPL3 chips; more chips raise the polyphony limit. - [code]four_op_channels[/code] (int): four-operator channels across all chips; [code]-1[/code] chooses automatically from the bank. - [code]volume_model[/code] (int): velocity scaling curve matching a specific driver or sound card. - [code]emulator[/code] (int): OPL3 emulator core (Nuked, DOSBox, Opal, YMFM, ESFMu, MAME, ...). - [code]full_range_brightness[/code] (bool): if [code]true[/code], CC74 scales over 0-127 instead of 0-64. Parameters are read when playback starts; changing them while playing has no effect until the next play. This class can't be instantiated directly. Use [AudioStreamMIDI] to play a MIDI file, or [AudioStreamMIDISequencer] to drive the synthesizer live with no fixed song.

members.member: Raw bytes of a custom WOPL instrument bank to load. Takes priority over the [code]embedded_bank[/code] parameter when non-empty.
